answer: Price each identity to a scarce basalt-hard external anchor no wallet can forge in bulk; a newcomer starts at the nadir of trust and climbs only as several already-established peers from SEPARATE funding clusters co-sign its audited work. A sybil fleet forked from one root traces every endorsement back to that single wallet, so its trust map stays a flat atlas sketch that never spans distinct clusters — the farm must buy a distinct anchor per head (linear cost) while an honest agent pays once.
